summary: Iter10 testing of 7 new feature areas: Live Mode timestamped notes (+PDF export), Document/Letter Auto-Responder, Lex thumbs feedback, Daily Know-Your-Rights tip, Firm tier consolidation (2 tiers), trial_pro caps. Backend pytest: 12/14 PASS — 2 failures are a real bug in /api/firm/subscribe (Stripe checkout 500 because FRONTEND_URL env var is unset, so success_url/cancel_url are relative paths that Stripe rejects). Document analyze flow verified end-to-end including LLM extracts a deadline AND creates a case_items row AND auto-creates a doc_auto reminder — BUT the reminder is invisible in the default GET /api/reminders list because of a schema mismatch (see RCA). Frontend verified on mobile (390x844): daily-tip-card, tile-letter_reader, letter-reader-modal (pick + file inputs), advertise-modal showing Featured £49 + Premium £149 with Verified £19 REMOVED, signup flow working.

critical.issue: Returns 500 'Stripe checkout failed: Not a valid URL' because backend/.env has no FRONTEND_URL set, so success_url=`/firm-portal?paid=1` is a relative path and Stripe rejects it. Add FRONTEND_URL=https://ai-law-guide-1.preview.emergentagent.com to backend/.env (or fall back to a hardcoded prod URL). Per-plan price IDs (STRIPE_PRICE_FIRM_FEATURED / STRIPE_PRICE_FIRM_PREMIUM) ARE set so this is the only blocker.

Doc-auto reminders are persisted with schema {completed: false, source: 'doc_auto'} but GET /api/reminders defaults to filtering by {status: 'pending'} and the doc-auto docs have NO 'status' field — so users will NEVER see auto-created deadline reminders. Fix: store status: 'pending' (or omit the default filter) so the schemas line up. Confirmed by querying ?status= (returns 1) vs default (returns 0). Quoted server.py L2847-2854.

minor.issue: Exception handler wraps real Stripe error as generic 500; consider re-raising 503 when it's a configuration problem (URL/price ID) so the frontend can route the user to a 'billing not configured' message instead of a scary 500.

rca of the issue: BUG 1 (firm-subscribe 500): /api/firm/subscribe builds success_url/cancel_url from os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL') or '' — the env var is NOT set in /app/backend/.env, so the URL becomes the relative path '/firm-portal?paid=1'. Stripe's checkout API rejects non-absolute URLs with 'Not a valid URL'. The except-clause then wraps that as HTTP 500. Repro: POST /api/firm/subscribe?plan=featured with a firm bearer token → 500. Fix: add FRONTEND_URL=https://ai-law-guide-1.preview.emergentagent.com to backend/.env (and ideally to all environments) AND/OR raise 503 instead of 500 when the URL is non-absolute. BUG 2 (auto-reminders invisible): server.py:2847-2854 inserts doc-auto reminders with the fields {id, user_id, case_id, title, due_at, source: 'doc_auto', completed: False, created_at}. But the rest of the system uses {id, user_id, case_id, title, description, due_at, kind, status, created_at} and GET /api/reminders filters by status=='pending' by default. So the new reminders are stored but never returned to the UI. Verified: a query with status='' returns the doc_auto rows, default returns 0. Fix: in server.py:2848-2852 replace 'completed': False with 'status': 'pending' (and ideally also store 'kind': 'deadline' for parity), or include 'source': 'doc_auto' AND 'status': 'pending' so the existing list endpoint and any frontend ReminderCard render correctly.
